messages:
deploy-bot: Canary rollout kicking off — service=reranker-svc, version=2026.04-rc1, target=10%, region=us-central, change_window=01:00-04:00 UTC. Please monitor SLOs and error channels. :rocket:

rachel: noticed p99 jump at ~01:07 UTC, p99 ~180ms over baseline and an uptick of 429s (0.15%). opening the reranker dashboard now.

dan: dashboard https://dash.redwood.ai/d/efgh/reranker-svc-traffic 7% of 429s map to one replica set. tracing shows throttles from the internal rate-limiter.

tony: could be the new batching handshake in rc1 increasing concurrent token windows. We saw similar earlier in staging.

priya: running a quick logs tail to correlate trace ids:
```
# tail logs
service:reranker-svc level:error status:429 | sort by timestamp desc | limit 20
# -> repeated 429s from host us-central-3, gateway throttle
```

deploy-bot: Canary at 10%. SLO guard triggered: 429_rate_threshold=0.1%, current=0.15% -> alerting thread. :warning:

rachel: given the throttle pattern, recommend pausing canary in us-central and pin routing to 2026.03-stable while we triage. Minimize blast radius.

dan: agree. We should also annotate release notes and open a triage ticket.

tony: operational command (if infra agrees): `trafficctl set-route --service reranker-svc --region us-central --version 2026.03-stable --weight 100 --reason "canary hold: p99/429 surge"`

infra-bot: executing command: `trafficctl set-route --service reranker-svc --region us-central --version 2026.03-stable --weight 100 --reason "canary hold: p99/429 surge"`

infra-bot: Result:
```
Updating routing policy... OK
Scaling down rc1 in region us-central... OK
Routing now 100% -> 2026.03-stable for reranker-svc in us-central
```

infra-bot: Created ticket https://tickets.redwood.ai/ENG-5201 (canary pause + triage). Notifying oncall.

deploy-bot: Canary paused for region us-central; recorded in deploy log https://deploy.redwood.ai/logs/1769969998. Canary status: STOPPED for us-central.

priya: adding metric snippets to ENG-5201: `sum(rate(reranker_request_429_total[5m])) by (host)` shows spikes on us-central-3, correlated with a +2x spike in average concurrency.

rachel: I'll take lead on triage - likely ramp/concurrency knob in the handshake layer. Dan/Tony, can you reproduce with a controlled replay of batched requests?

dan: on it. I'll run a replay job against a staging cluster with rc1 and compare rate-limiter counters.

tony: updating release notes with a one-line: "Canary paused in us-central due to p99/429 spike; pinned to 2026.03-stable while investigating rate-limiter/concurrency behavior (ENG-5201)."

infra-bot: Tagging change window entry `canary-paused` and alerting infra oncall.

priya: saved sample trace ids to ENG-5201 and attached the logs. Also noted a small CPU bump on those pods during the spike.

rachel: thanks everyone. Good catch. We'll reconvene once triage yields a fix or repro. Closing watch; deploy-bot will re-open thread if new alerts appear. :white_check_mark:
